scientific_question: How dependent is the exact adversarial eleven-label tipping result on WHICH short-followup eel labels are hypothetical unseen migration initiators?
source: Same 575 eel panel, 422 source initiators, 153 noninitiators; only 100 negative labels lacking documented 90-day follow-up are relabelable.
frozen_scores: Exact project-held-out base and condition-augmented activation scores from analysis/36, without refit or recalibration under hypothetical labels.

scenarios.description: Fix exactly k hypothetical hidden starts, uniformly sample k of 100 ambiguous negative fish; noninformative assignment reference, NOT an empirical missingness mechanism.
Fix exactly k hidden starts; assign sampling weights 3 to FV, 1 to FIII/FIV. Illustrative, uncalibrated higher-late-silvering missed-initiation scenario, not an estimated probability.

Fix exactly k hidden starts; sampling odds 3:1 for ambiguous fish whose positive relabeling contributes the most negative rank-change impacts (lowest third); illustrative score-related missing-not-at-random process, NOT biological evidence.

primary: For each k and scenario, recompute exact frozen-score within-project-year pair-weighted AUC increment over plausible label assignments, preserving the project-year strata and removing positives from negative comparison sets.
simulation: 10000 conditional draws per k/scenario, seed=20261008. k=0 and 100 deterministic. Quantiles and Pr(Delta AUC <= 0) describe the specified counterfactual assignment model only.
numerical_check: Validate each random draw's fast antisymmetric pairwise score numerator and changed denominator against a direct O(n²) AUC recomputation on synthetic small strata; also validate exact envelope containment for k=11.
interpretation: The uniform model is a reference distribution over hypothetical label assignments and does not estimate how many genuine undetected initiators exist.
The stage-enriched and adverse rank-disagreement scenarios are uncalibrated MNAR sensitivity functions, not estimators or causal mechanisms.
All source labels and fitted coefficients remain unchanged in the canonical analyses.
Eleven adversarial flips is an exact worst-case vulnerability; random-assignment probabilities cannot substitute for independent receiver exposure or downstream tracking evidence.
No claim about real false-negative prevalence, population escapement, eventual survival or physiological energy budget.
